mapper.insert: INSERT INTO follows (follower_id, following_id, created_at) VALUES (#{followerId}, #{followingId}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT m.member_id, m.nickname, CASE WHEN m.profile_image IS NOT NULL THEN '/api/members/' || m.member_id || '/profile-image' ELSE NULL END AS profile_image FROM follows f JOIN members m ON f.follower_id = m.member_id WHERE f.following_id = #{memberId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC

SELECT m.member_id, m.nickname, CASE WHEN m.profile_image IS NOT NULL THEN '/api/members/' || m.member_id || '/profile-image' ELSE NULL END AS profile_image FROM follows f JOIN members m ON f.following_id = m.member_id WHERE f.follower_id = #{memberId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC

SELECT p.post_id, p.member_id, p.title, p.content, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.is_public, p.is_temp, p.is_deleted, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.deleted_at FROM follows f JOIN posts p ON f.following_id = p.member_id WHERE f.follower_id = #{memberId} AND p.is_deleted = 'N' AND p.is_temp = 'N' AND p.is_public = 'Y' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
